section: Safety hazard: mechanical parts of the appliance
markdown:
| Danger                                                                   | Where or in what situations does the hazard arise?                               | Preventative action                                                             |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Risk of cuts from sharp edges                                            | During servicing work When handling sheet-metal parts                            | Exercise caution when performing this action Wear personal protective equipment |
| Risk of body parts being crushed if the appliance tips over or falls off | When the appliance is being moved e.g., to gain better access to the connections | Always observe the requirements for the supporting surface                      |
